description: This file defines a PHP class 'PreMigrationCheck' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Installer\Controller\Upgrader\Api'. The class extends an abstract REST controller and implements a handlePost method to perform pre-migration permission checks related to database user privileges during the installation or upgrade process of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: PreMigrationCheck
classes.description: Handles pre-migration database permission checks during system upgrade, specifically checking database user privileges.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to perform the database privilege evaluation and update migration state.
